name: call-to-action-18
description: Four audience cards for startups, agencies, enterprise and education, each with its own link CTA.

files.content:
import { ArrowUpRight, Briefcase, Building2, GraduationCap, Rocket } from "lucide-react" const audiences = [ { icon: Rocket, title: "Startups", body: "Free credits for your first year if you have raised under $5M.", cta: "Apply for credits", }, { icon: Briefcase, title: "Agencies", body: "White-label client workspaces and a 30% partner revenue share.", cta: "Join partner program", }, { icon: Building2, title: "Enterprise", body: "SSO, audit logs, data residency and a named account team.", cta: "Contact sales", }, { icon: GraduationCap, title: "Education", body: "Unlimited seats for verified students, teachers and classrooms.", cta: "Verify your school", }, ] export default function CallToAction18() { return (

Pick the path that fits your team.

Same product, tailored terms. Choose where you are today and we will set you up accordingly.

{audiences.map(({ icon: Icon, title, body, cta }) => (

{title}

{body}

{cta} ))}
) }
